title: payloads/<type>.v<n>.json
description: The rules every event payload schema follows. The instance is the payload schema itself. A payload holds ids, numbers and short fixed values only (PRD, Event log, principle 7): test/contract/payload_schemas_test.rb also requires every string property, at any depth, to be closed by enum, const, format uuid or format date-time.

title.description: The event type and the version, as in the file name: "task.created v1".
